## Smoking, Life Expectancy and Chronic Disease in the United States

<iframe src="fem.pdf" style="width: 100%; height: 600px; border: none;"></iframe>

As part of my research group I utiltized the Health and Retirement Student to create a logistic model. I then used this model to create a counterfactual simulation to predict subjects' cumulative smoking to study how health outcomes change with smoking habit changes.
